If there are $a$ different first letters and $b$ different last letters, then we can form $a \cdot 16 \cdot b$ different words (and the desired conditions will be met). Given the constraints $0 \leq a, b ; a+b \leq 16$, this product is maximized when $a=b=8$, giving the answer.
